title: Ask runs on the best model this Mac can hold, picked by the scores
goal: Ask today runs on a year-old model that cannot see. Try the current local models that can both see and use tools, score each on the eval, and make the winner the default, so every drawing, sheet and redline starts from the best brain this Mac has.
notes:
The user, 2026-10-20: 'what is the local model we're using? maybe we're not using the best model.' Today: qwen3:30b (pulled 12 months ago, text only), chosen on 2026-10-19 against only what was already on this Mac (gpt-oss 20B, a community Qwen3 2507 build, Apple's on-device model; queue/audits/2026-10-19-ask.json, docs/design/ask.md). Ollama 0.20.2 here; 517 GB free on disk. ollama.com/library on 2026-10-20 shows qwen3.6, gemma4 and qwen3-vl with vision, tools and thinking. Web guides also push gpt-oss-120b for tool calls, but it is about 62 GB and does not fit beside the app on 64 GB; leave it out unless a smaller quant is shown to fit. The juilpark gemma-4 'uncensored' community build already on the Mac is not a candidate.

Runs right after ask-draws-a-dog-you-can-tell-is-a-dog (in progress) and before the illustration and component tasks, so they climb on the new model. A model change can move every eval score, so the next tasks re-baseline after this lands.

Score the bake-off on the held-out set from the-test-set-cannot-be-passed-by-a-lookup-unseen, not only the climbable cases.
acceptance: Candidates pulled and run on the eval's whole case set through Ask, one at a time: qwen3.6:27b, qwen3.6:35b, gemma4:26b, gemma4:31b, qwen3-vl:30b, mistral-small3.2:24b, and the current qwen3:30b as the baseline; the -mlx builds too where Ollama offers them (Ollama's MLX engine on Apple Silicon). Only real Ollama tags (checked on ollama.com/library 2026-10-20: qwen3.6 27b/35b, gemma4 12b/26b/31b, qwen3-vl 8b/30b/32b, mistral-small3.2 24b), never a :cloud one

A table in the audit, per model: eval total and per category (drawings, sheets, redlines, video), blind naming score, seconds per request (median), memory in use, and how often a tool call came back broken

The default becomes the best scorer that answers a request in under 30 seconds median on this M4 Max with 64 GB and leaves room for the app and a browser; Settings' Automatic picks it, and a Mac with less memory gets the best that fits (the rule written down in the audit)
If the winner can see, Ask's look-and-revise step uses the same model instead of a second one, and that is measured against two models too

Ollama itself is brought up to date first if a newer one is out, and the version is in the audit. Downloads are run one at a time, the models that lose are removed again so the disk is left as found (plus the winner), and nothing is left running. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not
